parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing restrictions are largely absent: no clothing ban, no birth-sex facility rule, and same-sex conduct was decriminalized in 1998. Resident gaps on legal gender recognition, adoption, marriage and discrimination protection are not deducted as traveler exposure. The current 2025 anti-propaganda law, however, creates a real traveler-facing threat for visible LGBTQ identity, with possible arrest and fines, even though the dossier does not document enforcement against trans visitors or organized targeting. Bias-violence recourse is weak: no hate-crime data/point of contact and one uninvestigated incident; dated attitudes and court privacy ruling are secondary. Thin evidence therefore resolves to elevated risk: above jurisdictions with universal facility/custody exclusion, but below accepting places with working visitor remedies.
